tless_coop_ablation.description: T-LESS Co-op ablation from Table 4: single-view candidates versus full 4-view aggregation, NMS, and refinement.

AR.description: Average recall over ADD-style pose-error thresholds on the selected multi-view scenes.

AP.description: Detection-style pose accuracy at the central ADD threshold.

complete_prediction_rate.description: Fraction of selected scenes with a usable prediction, preventing methods from omitting hard cases.

candidate_add_gain_pct.description: Average ADD improvement over the best supplied single-view candidate, normalized by object diameter.

exact_pose_copy_rate.description: Sentinel for exact ground-truth pose copying from the benchmark JSON rather than solving the pose task.

mean_add_error.description: Mean ADD-style 3D pose error over all selected scenes, with missing predictions counted as failures.

median_translation_error.description: Median translation error in world coordinates.

median_rotation_error_deg.description: Median geodesic rotation error in degrees.

mean_final_candidates.description: Average number of retained final hypotheses, discouraging duplicate-candidate flooding.

num_views.description: Number of calibrated RGB views consumed by the method, tracked as a mild resource constraint.

uses_depth_sensor.description: Constraint flag penalizing methods that use measured depth despite the RGB-only target setting.

object_specific_training.description: Constraint flag penalizing object-specific training in the unseen-object/generalized-pose setting.

uses_dinov2_features.description: Informational flag for whether the submitted method uses DINOv2-style frozen features.

ycbv_coop_ablation.description: YCB-V Co-op ablation from Table 4: single-view candidates versus full 4-view aggregation, NMS, and refinement.

AR.description: Average recall over BOP pose-error thresholds.

AP.description: Average precision over BOP pose-error thresholds.

AR.description: Average recall over BOP pose-error thresholds for unseen ITODD-MV objects.

AP.description: Average precision over BOP pose-error thresholds for unseen ITODD-MV objects.

housecat6d_foundpose.description: HouseCat6D unseen object result from Table 8 using FoundPose candidates.
